Charlson Comorbidity Index — FHIR Questionnaire Template

Comorbidities and age with the age-adjusted Charlson Comorbidity Index.

Open in Builder

Scoring

Comorbidities score 1, 2, 3 or 6 points by weight; the age adds 1 point per decade from 50, up to 4 points from age 80. The index appears once the age is entered; an unanswered comorbidity counts as No.

Source and license

Source: Charlson et al. 1987, J Chronic Dis 40:373; age adjustment per Charlson et al. 1994, J Clin Epidemiol 47:1245. (link)

License: Original wording written for this builder; covered by the project license (non-commercial use with attribution; commercial use needs written permission). Formulas are published methods; see the source. (link)

Provided to save authoring effort, not as medical advice — confirm the scale and its cut-offs for your use case.

Use it

  1. Download the FHIR Questionnaire JSON, or
  2. open it in the Builder right away (or open the Builder, choose + Add → From template… and search for “Charlson Comorbidity Index”). It arrives as one titled group with its calculations wired, and you can keep editing it.
